title: A new test never reads the checkout's own origin/main, so a merge that moves main cannot turn a ready run red
why:
INCIDENT (coordinator 23:57 CST Nov 14, relayed to triage as data; its read unless marked): PR #3448 (branch rct-carry-main-merge, step carry-forgives-main-merge, lane review-carries-by-tree) had a ready run, run 43682083778 at head c6b4139f1d62, marked 23:41 CST. Its job checks-merge-git went red at 23:55:52 CST (REST read; the run itself is still in progress). Per runner 10's read of that job's log, four new tests in the PR read the checkout's real origin/main (stale_tip_fixture asserts main_tip() equals fx.M), and #3438's merge at 23:49:53 CST moved main during the run, so the assertion failed. The PR had passed the lane's own runs, three review rounds and the lane lint. About 14 min of CI wasted (23:41 to 23:55, the coordinator's arithmetic, one run, n=1). MISTAKE (building-guard-needs-incident): a test fixture depends on the live remote of the checkout it runs in, so its result changes when another PR merges. HARM IT STOPS: a red ready run after a moving main, which costs a CI cycle and holds the PR's hand-in. GUARD (either; the first act of the lane is to pick one and name why): (1) a check that fails a test or fixture that reads the checkout's own origin/main (or main_tip() of the real checkout) instead of the fixture's own bare origin; or (2) a line in the reviewer's brief: probe each new test for a dependency on the live remote (state that moves with other merges). A check must pass the scanner rules (comment openers inside strings) and must go red on this incident's fixture first (verification-trust-guard-after-red). READ BY TRIAGE (REST, 23:59 CST): PR #3448 is open, draft, head c6b4139f1d629ef95892f08f7ce1e56e6b17a956, base main dc35317d3b40, 12 commits, 2 files changed. Run 43682083778 (event pull_request, head c6b4139f1d629ef95892f08f7ce1e56e6b17a956, created 05:40:26Z): the RUN reads status in_progress, no conclusion, updated 05:57:09Z (other jobs still going). The JOB checks-merge-git (id 132714887666), step "Merge tool git-half fixture suite", reads conclusion failure, completed 05:55:52Z (23:55:52 CST). So the red is a job verdict; the run has no conclusion yet. Read by REST (coordinator 23:58 CST, repeated by this triage's fork 00:00 CST). The four-test cause (stale_tip_fixture, "the checkout's origin/main moved") is runner 10's read of the job's log: neither the coordinator nor triage read it. A later green run on the same head exists for lane-touched-tests only (run 43683185992, success, 05:56:12Z, the coordinator's read). CAUSE per the #3448 lane's own read of job 132714887666 (00:00 CST Nov 14, lane report relayed by the coordinator; neither the coordinator nor triage read the log): 4 failed of 1711, one assertion at merge/test_merge.py:15438 (self.main_tip() != fx.M), main_tip() a different sha in each (51008c09f157, 2dd96fa13e04, e4ab0f90e480, 66c24cc2842a); the fixture depends on its checkout's origin/main. The runner's git is 2.56.1; the "silent-undo UNKNOWN (git older than 2.38)" line comes from a scripted fake git in another test, so it is not a runner-git cause. Not read by triage: the test file, stale_tip_fixture, the job log. RELATED: lane review-carries-by-tree is fixing the fixture now (coordinator 23:57). No design lane yet.

00:30 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, data): held until #3448's hermetic fixture lands; the #3448 lane builds the first fixes, this check follows.

00:50 CST Nov 15 SAME CLASS, unconfirmed (coordinator's relay of lane docs-drafts-records; neither the coordinator nor triage read the test file or the log): a test reads state outside its fixture. Here the live remote; in lint/test_check_debt_retire.py test_c7 the calling environment's GH_REPO (green alone, red inside `merge --lane-lint` twice in that lane's environment). If confirmed, the check for this step may cover both: a test builds its own environment, remote and variables. Runner 10 runs that lint in its own environment next.

01:03 CST Nov 15 CAUSE of #3448's 4 red cases (coordinator's relay of the lane's read; triage read no test or log): git 2.56.1 treats `git push <url>` as a push to the remote whose push url equals that url and moves its tracking refs, so the old fixture moved the checkout's origin/main on the runner (2.56.1) but not locally (2.43). The new fixture pushes only a side ref and moves main with update-ref inside the bare. Open note for a later edit: the fixture docstring does not say why it avoids a path push to main. PR #3448 by REST 01:03 CST: open draft, head 7b85dbe8b33c, mergeable_state clean; review record 6890500223 and lane lint 6890790389 are relayed ids, not read. 01:54 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 01:53, relayed): lane started, session_013NEJKzUafS54P62m7PucUt, checked with get_session at 01:54 CST (running, connected, created 01:52 CST, parent the coordinator, tags cs-step:tests-never-read-live-origin-main). The incident PR #3448 has merged (01:52:11 CST), so the lane reads a merged fixture fix, not a live PR.

04:07 CST Nov 15 HAND-IN (coordinator 04:07, relayed from lane session_013NEJKzUafS54P62m7PucUt; lane facts unchecked by triage unless marked): PR #3494 by REST 04:07 CST: open, draft, head 17c64a217537216158a5787163bd808369a84c85, 4 commits, 2 files, mergeable_state clean, base main cd0dfe374c42. Guard picked (2): a probe line in the reviewer's and test-author's agent files; no scanner check, since the lane's audit of 205 test files found no second reader of the live origin/main (PR body, read by triage). Review record 6892528253: round 1 haiku FAIL, round 2 sonnet FAIL, round 3 sonnet PASS, net zero. Lane lint comment 6892739240 PASS at head (relayed, not read), relayed to runner 10. LANE REFUSAL: the harness classifier refused with reason [Undermining Oversight] the lane's command `verdict ~/.claude/bin/merge --lint 3494@17c64a217537216158a5787163bd808369a84c85:PASS`, which printed a lint line by hand in the `--lint <pr>@<head>:PASS` form. The lane did not retry or hand-post; no owner item, no override. Note only: a lane runs `merge --lane-lint` and lets the tool post the PASS line, never prints one itself. No existing step covers a lane printing its own lint PASS line (lane-lint-background-refused is about a refused background run, a different act). AUDIT NOTES, unfixed (PR body): lint/test_prove_route_judge.py:231 reads the real checkout's object store, red on a shallow clone (proven, different class: clone depth); hooks/test_ci_wake.py:211 call_repo reads the caller's GH_REPO (latent, unproven); hooks/test_guard.py and hooks/test_install_src.sh timed out for the lane, so their verdict is UNKNOWN, not clear. TRAILER: the commit on 17c64a217537 reads `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5` while the lane's session read claude-sonnet-5-5 (get_session last_served_model, the lane's read); a wording slip, not model drift; filed as a sighting on step commit-trailer-model, which already holds the rule and the check. No pick taken.
